races.name: Your Elite Club Handicap
races.verdict: PACIFIC STORM is bred to stay very well and might be worth chancing making his handicap debut in a visor. Recent course winner Fram Castle is respected over this longer trip, with Al's River completing the shortlist.

races.name: Stella Artois Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict: MOTAWAARED hasn't done much wrong of late and perhaps this is the day he finally gets his head in front. Falcon Nine is another who has been knocking on the door in recent starts and is second choice under Jack Nicholls. Newmarket raider Ghost Story is next on the list.

Ran best race this season when close second at Hamilton (13f, soft) last month but not in the same form back there 17 days ago. Others are more persuasive.

Yet to score this season but holding her form well, creditable fourth of 14 in handicap at Kempton (11f) 15 days ago, unable to sustain effort. One to consider.
Quirky maiden but has been firmly knocking on the door in recent weeks, pulling clear of the rest when second over 1m here (heavy) 9 days ago. Likely to be in the thick of things again.

Yet to add to his tally this year but has been knocking on the door, finishing runner-up at Haydock and Newcastle the last twice. Respected.
Has reached the frame 3 times in handicaps at up to 1m and the way he plugged on for fourth at Southwell last time suggests this slightly longer trip is worth a go.
Gained a deserved fourth success at Musselburgh (13f) in July but has struggled since.

races.name: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (Smullen Series)
races.verdict: KING CHRISTOPH finished a promising second on debut at Listowel and may well go one better here. Group 1-entered Dawnmore probably did too much too soon when third in the same maiden and has to be feared, while Battle Ready is no back number on his Leopardstown form.

runners.note: Sent off at 150/1 when going with no promise on debut at Punchestown (1m, good).

races.verdict: KERRY GREY made up plenty of late ground at Wolverhampton on debut and Richard Hughes' filly is expected to build on that. Pontefract third Casting Coach and Chanter Le Blues, who made an encouraging start back in the spring, are also shortlisted.

races.name: Menabrea Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: CATURRA ROCK's opening Yarmouth second came at big odds but there appeared to be no fluke about it and he's taken to go one better now. Sea Mirage and Muve On are the pair likely to give him most to do.

runners.note: Promising second of 6 in novice (66/1) at Yarmouth (6f, good) on debut 23 days ago, running on. Leading claims with improvement likely.

races.name: BOYLE Sports Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict: THE BLUE PANTHER is taken to go one better than on stable debut. Hat-trick seeking Starflow rates the chief threat, ahead of Free Solo and Imperial Dream.

races.name: Tractor Drivers Go Free On 12th November Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: NIGHTFLYER has had the form of his Uttoxeter win boosted by the second scoring at Kelso on Sunday and is the percentage call, although strong support for Irish point recruit Port Glen One would put a slightly different slant on things.
